method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (vocfa-core.l4, with ten regulative rules for the duties of the applicant, the assisted person, the commissioner and the applicant's lawyer) and a seat layer (vocfa-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (an act before 1 July 2016 and the parts left out answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Victims of Crime (Financial Assistance) Act 2016 (ACT) A2016-12, Republication No 10 (R10), effective 26 November 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A2016-12.txt; with the Victims of Crime (Financial Assistance) Regulation 2016 (ACT) SL2016-10, Republication No 11 (R11), effective 1 July 2026, as deposited at ../../../victims-of-crime-financial-assistance-regulation-2016/registers/source-bundle/SL2016-10.txt (every dollar figure; the s 25 CPI and s 97 WPI indexation taken as already reflected in R11)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run vocfa-core.l4 ; l4 run vocfa-seat.l4 ; l4 run vocfa-cases-applicant.l4
checks.result: 147 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 9 #TRACEs with an expect line (4 breaches, 5 obligations pending), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the applicant: pt 2 ss 7, 9, 10, 11, 12-15, 16, 17 with schedule 1 and the dictionary (sexual offence, offence against the person, schedule 1 offence, dependant, relevant person); pt 3 ss 18-23 (eligibility), s 24 with reg s 5 (maximum), s 26 with reg s 6 and table 6 (immediate need), s 27 with reg s 7 and table 7 (economic loss), ss 28-30 with reg ss 8-10 and table 8 (recognition), s 31 (requirements, evidence, special reporting class), s 32 (time; extension answered conditionally), s 33, s 45 (findings as facts, 14-day reply), s 47 (reductions as amounts); pt 4 ss 51-55 and s 60 with reg s 11 (funeral); pt 5 ss 62, 64-67 (notification, repayment amount, arrangement and direction notices, liability); s 92 (2) and schedule 2 (reconsideration deadline); s 96 with reg s 12 (lawyers' costs). Not covered, each answering an asserted `not covered` value: recovery from the offender (pt 6), the levy (pt 7), administration and secrecy (pt 8), ACAT review procedure beyond the deadlines (pt 9), applications for criminal injuries before 1 July 2016 (s 98), the commissioner's guidelines (s 87, not deposited). Not reached: div 3.5, ss 34-37, 42, 44, 48, div 3.7, ss 56-59, 61, 63, 68, 95A, 99-101. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991/ (s 17 (2B): criminal injury compensation is not compensation) and subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997/ (s 118-37); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seats: the applicant: a primary victim, a class A, B or C related victim, or a homicide witness (and, for pt 4, the person who paid or is liable for a homicide victim's funeral)
